name: review-desk
title: Discovery review desk
subtitle: Internal working records. No authority to disclose.

sections.title: Review queue
sections.sql: select source_id,name,owner,due_date,issue from attention order by due_date nulls last,source_id

sections.title: Disclosure readiness
sections.sql: select source_id,name,readiness from disclosure_register order by source_id

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select source_id,rule,issue from compliance_checks order by source_id,rule

sections.title: Family gaps
sections.sql: select source_id,name,parent_id,issue from family_gaps order by source_id
